quest.title: That Which Fell From the Sky
quest.description: Due to the constant descent of meteorites from the sky, it has become too unsafe to go outside. Sister Grace is very worried about those people who linger out there in the wild...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Might x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I pray that everyone remains safe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. I suppose you've seen the meteorites too, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Fortunately, none of them landed inside the city, but I'm worried for those who are still outside. It must be a huge mess at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you please help us warn them?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: If they're willing, please invite them to seek shelter within the city.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: You can look for Lynn first. Perhaps she knows who is and isn't still lingering in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Do try to convince her to seek shelter in Mondstadt herself.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: This... really isn't the time for "surviving in the wilderness."

choices.text: Why didn't any of the meteorites land inside the city?

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Perhaps it was just good fortune. Whatever the case, the city of Mondstadt is the safer place to be for now.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: At least, it's better than being outside the city... wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: These conditions do make surviving in the wilderness quite challenging, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please seek shelter inside Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Seek shelter? Oh, don't worry about me. I'm always watching my surroundings. I'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: That said, why are you still out here? You should head back to Mondstadt — you might get hit by one of those meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why, yes — on the topic of people still out here...

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: People still out here? There's a lot of them, actually — why do you ask?

choices.text: To get them to seek shelter.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Oh, so that's what it is... The Guild actually sent out commissions to that effect. I've notified quite a few people nearby myself.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Those closer to the city have all gone inside to seek shelter.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: But we've been unable to get very many adventurers on the case because we're short on help, so there's still quite a few people who have gone unnotified. If you're willing to help, that would be great.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Give me a moment to remember who's still out here...

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Ah, that's right! I believe Patchi and Doolan are still at the Thousand Winds Temple. I've tried to warn them, but they insisted on continuing their research there.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: There's also Vind, who's remained at Stormbearer Point all this while. The Guild asked me to look for her a few times, but I was never able to find her.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: That's all the people who come to mind for now. I guess you can start with them.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: As for me, I'll give the area another sweep and notify anyone I can find once I'm done preparing some food and other necessities.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Let's just hope they haven't run off too far, or it'll be hard for them to return to the city even if we do find them.

choices.text: Sister Grace is very concerned about them.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Grace? So you're here on her behest... Actually, the Guild's sent out commissions to that effect, and I've notified quite a few people nearby myself.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: Those closer to the city have all gone inside to seek shelter.

response.speaker: Lynn
response.text: But we've been unable to get very many adventurers on the case because we're short on help, so there's still quite a few people who have gone unnotified. If you're willing to help, that would be great.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: This is no time for research, we should find a place to take cover!

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I've said it before, and I'll say it again. I'm not letting this opportunity slip by.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, please seek shelter within Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: This again? Now isn't the time for seeking shelter. These meteorites may yet present us with an opportunity to get deeper inside the Thousand Winds Temple.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Deeper inside the temple?

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Patchi says that if a meteorite hits the Thousand Winds Temple, we'll be able to follow its path into the temple's inner chambers... or whatever else may be underneath.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: But this is wishful thinking. If a meteorite does strike the temple, we wouldn't be able to get away in time.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: We should really take cover somewhere. And if a meteorite were to hit the Thousand Winds Temple and open a path beyond, couldn't we just come back later and explore it then?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: But what if someone gets there before we do? If you want to go back, go yourself. I'll wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: But... Alright, then. I'm sorry, Traveler, but I think the two of us will stay here for a while more.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Don't worry. If there's any danger, I... I'll settle it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Oh, that reminds me... There was a person named Schuster who passed this way earlier, looking all shaken up...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: He asked me for a sip of water, before saying that he had to get to Mondstadt and hurrying off.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: But he wasn't running in the direction of the city at all — he was headed towards Stormbearer Point instead.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Perhaps... he might have forgotten the way in his fright.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: You should also head that way and look for him near Stormbearer Point. I can't imagine what might happen if he runs into some monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: I'll keep Patchi company here, and if something really does happen... Um, I'll handle things myself.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Agh! Y—You... Oh, you're not a monster...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, please seek shelter within Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I—I know that I should! Why, I'm out here notifying people to seek shelter as well. I might have taken a few extra turns, yes, but still—!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, so why are you hiding over here, then?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I... I'm resting! Something wrong with that? D—Don't you worry about me! Just head back to Mondstadt... or something.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Meteorites and monsters... Does anyone out and about at this time have anything in their braincases at all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, are there any other people out and about right now?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I was looking for Vind, actually... by which I mean that sister who is always seen around Stormbearer Point.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I searched that entire area, but I couldn't find her, so I went somewhere else to try my luck there...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: But I was discovered by a group of crazed monsters instead. Just barely escaped them.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I twisted and turned this way and that, all the way back to Stormbearer Point — still no sign of Vind.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I can only hope that sister's already back inside Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm heading back to the city. You should go back as well. This is no time to be taking outdoor strolls...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Hmm? What brings you here, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I was walking around, watching the ocean, so I probably wasn't all that easy to find... Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you please return to Mondstadt to seek shelter?

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Seek shelter? Ah, you're referring to those meteorites. I understand, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Watch out! We've got monsters incoming!

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Phew... Thank you, that was quite a close call.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And that's why I asked you to seek shelter.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I can't go back right now. These meteorites are strange enough as it stands...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: In times like this, it wouldn't be surprising if a storm were to churn the seas again.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: I must keep watch here. If a storm does occur, I must be able to warn the city immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Thanks for informing me, though. I'll be more careful.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: You're back. Have you managed to notify all of them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes. None of them want to return right now, though...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: They all refused? One wonders what important tasks they must have, that they should feel compelled to stay in the wilderness at a time like this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guess that's the free people of Mondstadt for you...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Haha, that's true. The people of Mondstadt are as free as the wind, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Still, I do wish that they could rein it in at times.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Knights likely have their hands full as well. It's alright — I will think of some other way to convince these people. Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I pray that everyone remains safe...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I pray that everyone remains safe...

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Looking for people out in the wilderness... Yeah, I guess that's part of survival training, too.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Why don't we go back and seek shelter? We can return and continue our research once it's safe.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I've said it a thousand times already, you can go back yourself. I won't let anyone beat me to this discovery!

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Let's hope that a storm doesn't come...
